secrets.name: GEMINI_API_KEY
secrets.description: Google Gemini API key (Google AI Studio → API keys). Used by the AI assistant, the AI problem solver and the news/game AI features. The app boots without it, but AI calls fail.

secrets.name: FIREBASE_API_KEY
secrets.description: Web app API key of the Firebase project in firebase-applet-config.json (Firebase Console → Project settings → Your apps → Web app → apiKey). The exported applet ships this value masked, so Google sign-in and all Firestore-backed screens need it.

secrets.name: GOOGLE_MAPS_PLATFORM_KEY
secrets.description: Optional. Google Maps JavaScript API key (Google Cloud Console → APIs & Services → Credentials) for the marketplace map view; without it the marketplace shows its list view.
